Sentence (English): After reading all the rave reviews for this dishwasher, I decided to get this dishwasher and I'm sorry I did.
Comments (English): After reading all the rave reviews for this dishwasher, I decided to get this dishwasher and I'm sorry I did. Some of the problems I have with it are:1. It does a poor job of drying the dishes. Even on the extended dry cycle, there's still water pooling on them.2. The "Smart" features are annoying. I thought I could just ignore the fact that the dishwasher is Smart but it turns out that several features are only available by going through the app. Then when I tried to get into it, the QR code on my dishwasher wasn't recognized and so far scanning for it by Bluetooth hasn't worked. Call me old fashioned but I dislike it when I can't run a dishwasher due to technologic failure.3. The internal configuration of the dishwasher is very limited. Due to the spacing and angle of the tines, the only things that fit comfortably in the bottom rack are dinner plates. That's fine if you're throwing dinner parties every day but here in the real world, the things I need to wash are different sizes and shapes and the rack just doesn't accommodate them easily if at all.4. The volume of the dishwasher is generally quiet as advertised but the drain cycles are quite noisy. It's not something I'd want to run if I was having a conversation near it due to the sudden loud noise it makes.

It does clean well, but still leaves some food behind. It is quiet and does a good job drying. I would have returned this if it hadn't taken three people to install in the first place, and who were too frustrated to repeat the process.

First, I had to use a power converter as the previous dishwasher was hardwired. The converter makes the dishwasher stick out from the cupboard by 1.5". It looks terrible. The door is hard to open, which would be difficult for the elderly and people with arthritis (like my mother demonstrated). The join between the control panel and the front of the door has a sharp lip, which I have scraped myself on when opening the door with the force required. The door also feels flimsy, so it twists if you don't pull it open from the centre. The configuration of the dishwasher racks makes loading awkward (I don't have odd-shaped dishes either). It does clean well, but still leaves some food behind. It is quiet and does a good job drying. I would have returned this if it hadn't taken three people to install in the first place, and who were too frustrated to repeat the process.

Sentence (English): I'm recently married and decided to select replacing the dishwasher as our first marriage squabble.
Comments (English): [ It's as if God is washing your dishes ] || ---------------- || I'm recently married and decided to select replacing the dishwasher as our first marriage squabble. I thought they were stupid until I had one. You HAVE to get a dishwasher with a third rack.2. You can truly accommodate dozens of different configurations with the adjustable prongs, wine glass holders, and rack heights.All that to say: if you want God to wash your dishes for you, buy this dishwasher.

Sentence (English): I purchased this dishwasher in December of 2022 at a big box store and enjoyed 10 months of dependable and quiet performance.
Comments (English): [ Do NOT buy this model Samsung DW80R9950US ] || ---------------- || I purchased this dishwasher in December of 2022 at a big box store and enjoyed 10 months of dependable and quiet performance. However, after these months the upper spray arm broke. A plastic part that clips the arm onto the middle rack became stretched causing the arm to fall down into the dishwasher with every use. The big box store's service person installed a replacement arm that broke, again, in less than a day. I tried to use the one-year warranty with Samsung, but my dealings with Samsung have been a disaster. Today I spent 20 minutes on the phone with an agent to generate a repair ticket, but the links that the agent sent don't work. First, a page reported that my machine was out of warranty (I previously provided Samsung with a copy of the big box receipt), then a page listed the wrong symptom and provided no way for me to explain or confirm the problem, and then the next page wanted me to pay $365 for service. I followed up with the agent who sent me another link that was no more helpful. I sent additional texts, but they have not been answered. Between the unsuccessful attempt by the big box store (with a repair person who was completely unfamiliar with this model) and the spectacular indifference or antipathy that Samsung has towards its customers, I very much regret this purchase. Do NOT buy this dishwasher (I think that the design of the spray arm is faulty) and be very wary of Samsung. If you think you ever will need product support, do NOT buy a Samsung product.

Comments (English): [ All good, except the bottom corners ] || ---------------- || Dishwasher review Bought this dishwasher Dec 2022 and since then I had been noticing that the corners dishes in the bottom rack when put upside down never cleaned. Called the repair service and we found the issue. The bottom rotator is never able to direct the spray jet with water in all four bottom corners. So when anything is put upside down like pots or containers, they will never get any water to get cleaned. The drum is rectangular in shape and the rotators have to circle around, so the math there would suggest that it never reach the four bottom corners unless the spray jets are guided to spray in that direction, which it is not since the water jet sprays upwards. Knowing this I know now the best way to arrange my dishes in the washer but it leaves me with always trying to adjust to accommodate the system. Other than that, it's a great dishwasher to have.

Comments (English): [ I think it's well-installed for around 300,000 won. ] || ---------------- || It's bigger than I expected. I was using SK before, but after 5 years of use, the mainboard was diagnosed as dead, and an SK technician told me the repair cost was the same as buying a new one. So, I purchased a Samsung dishwasher that was on sale on Coupang. It was delivered within a week. I scheduled the installation date and time over the phone, and the installation proceeded. They arrived about an hour late on the day of installation, which made me angry, but I asked them to install it properly. The quick installation and the collection of the old SK dishwasher were good. After the installation, I listened to a brief explanation of how to use it, and after the technicians left, I noticed the drain hose had been twisted. The user manual mentioned that there is an extra charge if the drain hose is too short, so I wondered if they twisted it for that reason. However, since it wasn't the inlet line but the drain pipe that was twisted, I was worried that water would pool and cause an odor later. So, I untwisted it to let it go down straight, and I am currently using it that way. It is very good. Perhaps because the drum is large, it washes most items in one go. Frying pans, pots, various bowls, and plates all fit inside. It is even better than when I used the SK dishwasher. The SK one is small, so I had to run it two or three times if there was a lot of food, but this one does it all at once. It feels great to see the dishes come out clean. It really is convenient to have a good dishwasher.

Sentence (English): I have a Samsung dishwasher, and it was working normally, but it stopped spinning and the time did not decrease, so I brought a service technician to check it, and I was confused because it was a multi-tap problem.
Comments (English): I have a Samsung dishwasher, and it was working normally, but it stopped spinning and the time did not decrease, so I brought a service technician to check it, and I was confused because it was a multi-tap problem. I continued to use it well, but it was due to the lifespan of the multi-tap. Like an air conditioner, it has to be used individually, but some people don't know about it, and the cause was the power strip that individually shuts off (red tick). If you are connected to a multi-tap with a red tick, try using a multi-tap without a tick and call a business trip to solve the problem, but I felt very uncomfortable even after paying 50,000 won for the travel fee.

Sentence (English): We purchased this dishwasher on July 17.
Comments (English): [ Frustrating experience ] || ---------------- || We purchased this dishwasher on July 17. The first time we used it after 45 minutes into the cycle we got an error code indicating there was either too many suds in the dishwasher or it was not level. After having my plumber back out to confirm it was indeed level it took several long, frustrating calls with customer service and 3 in-home visits by an LG service technician to get to what causes my issue. It is caused by the detergent pods, Cascade Platinum Plus, that LG recommends (there was even a discount coupon included in the instruction manual). On his 3rd visit to my home, and after replacing a part on his 2nd visit that didn't fix the problem, my technician got someone at his corporate office to inform him that the pod needs to be cut open and the powder is then placed where the pod goes and the pod itself is then thrown out. The dishwasher now works fine when doing that but this whole experience was very frustrating. I had the option of returning the machine and getting another one but I learned that installation is not covered by the manufacturer's warranty. In Lowes defense the manager I spoke with said Lowes would cover the plumbing bill but after going back and forth with LG for over 3 months I decided to just keep it. Once I run out of pods I'll go to either liquid or pour-in loose detergent.

The first time we used it after 45 minutes into the cycle we got an error code indicating there was either too many suds in the dishwasher or it was not level. After having my plumber back out to confirm it was indeed level it took several long, frustrating calls with customer service and 3 in-home visits by an LG service technician to get to what causes my issue. It is caused by the detergent pods, Cascade Platinum Plus, that LG recommends (there was even a discount coupon included in the instruction manual). On his 3rd visit to my home, and after replacing a part on his 2nd visit that didn't fix the problem, my technician got someone at his corporate office to inform him that the pod needs to be cut open and the powder is then placed where the pod goes and the pod itself is then thrown out. The dishwasher now works fine when doing that but this whole experience was very frustrating. I had the option of returning the machine and getting another one but I learned that installation is not covered by the manufacturer's warranty. In Lowes defense the manager I spoke with said Lowes would cover the plumbing bill but after going back and forth with LG for over 3 months I decided to just keep it. Once I run out of pods I'll go to either liquid or pour-in loose detergent.

I have trouble making decisions, but there are so many different colors that I thought about it all day. In the end, I decided on Kota White, which is the most common color that matches the sink color and doesn't stand out or get old. I didn't want the glass material to reflect handprints or mirrors, so I debated going with satin beige, but both would have been fine. Before I remodel the sink, I heard that it would be good to watch a video of things to check before installation, so I watched it and discovered that the sink drain pipe in my house was leaking. I didn't know because I didn't pour a lot of water at once, but I figured it out this time. Fortunately, it was repaired before installation. Please check before installation. I am very satisfied with the dishwasher. Previously, I was using an old 6-person dishwasher because I was renting it out, but this is a completely new world. Even if you put it in roughly, it goes in infinitely, and what surprised me was the sound, so quiet that I wondered if it was really running. I can't see the time outside, so I don't know if I'm going back. I used it twice in standard mode and once with high-temperature sterilization, but when I turned the hot air to the lowest setting, there was moisture in the basket and upper cutlery. I also used solid detergent that included rinse aid, but the glassware was stained. I roughly rinsed it with water and put it back in, and it was clean except for a little bit of the egg yolk stuck on it. I need to try the extensive course.

Sentence (English): I have had my dishwasher since Sept. 2022.
Comments (English): [ Horrible design ] || ---------------- || I have had my dishwasher since Sept. 2022. In November, the top control strip peeled off and I could not use it. I asked the repair technician why this strip is made so cheap and why does it peel off? His reply. "Because it gets wet" I said "This is a dishwasher, they get wet" Bad design. Anyway, they had to order the parts, took over 3 months to arrive so I had no dishwasher over the Thanksgiving and Christmas holidays. They repaired it in February 2023, it worked great until March or April when the strip peeled off again, had to schedule another service, order the parts etc, I did not get my dishwasher repaired until July. It is now November, the strip started peeling a few weeks ago, I have been trying to smash it down and get the glue to stick but it's off. I am now out of warranty. Thankfully they are going to honor my warranty but they said if it peels again, I'll have to purchase another dishwasher and they will give me a discount. So I paid $1000. + to use a dishwasher for maybe 4 months out of the year. It is also November again and I will likely be out of a dishwasher for the holidays for the second year in a row. When this lemon fails again, and we all know it is going to fail, I will buy a new one but never this brand. It's really a shame, it's nice looking but I didn't pay a thousand plus bucks to look at a pretty dishwasher.

Sentence (English): I've run this Series 300 dishwasher 3 times now.
Comments (English): [ This machine will DESTROY your plastics.  ] || ---------------- || I've run this Series 300 dishwasher 3 times now. I researched Drying Options prior to buying. This model featured the \"Pure Dry\" described as follows: . \"With PureDry® drying technology, moisture is gently whisked away from dishes as they cool. \". First 2 Cycles I used were:. -SPEED 60-. -AUTO-. ( Both with EXTRA DRY Option OFF ). Both cycles DESTROYED my plastics, and chipped paint off thermos bottles. ( Items that I had been washing for years in my old Bosch, without this problem. ). I called Bosch Customer Service to see if there was a way to minimize the Heat on this machine. They said I could not wash plastics and enameled items in this machine. :( . What a disaster. So I decided to experiment with the different Cycles & Options, that are best explored in the Bosch \" Home Connect \"APP. [ Trying to get these Settings on the machine's front panel requires such a convoluted sequencing of buttons and timing. honestly I gave up, and resorted to downloading the APP on a WiFi tablet I have at home ]. After experimenting with the different Options & Cycles, here is the one that I have had the best results for my plastics, thermos bottles, etc :. < Through the APP >. Programme Assistant : . ∆ WINE GLASSES. Dirtyness Level:. ∆ LIGHT. Priorities:. ∆ CLEANLINESS. -----. The above combo will wash in the \"DELICATE with ECO\" mode. Cycle Water Temperature is 113⁰, and Drying is at a 1½ of 3 level. So far so good. Everything comes out squeaky clean. I do not need nuclear fission heat levels to wash & dry my dishes. I am happy with my Dishwasher now. I hope Bosch reads this review, and uses it to help others that are about to return the machine to the store. When I started this review I was going to give it 1 Star. but once I . got the Cycle + Option figured out, the machine cleans & performs at a 5. ( Would have liked to upload pictures, but website keeps failing to upload )

Sentence (English): After several weeks of trying different ways to use this dishwasher, I have come to the conclusion that there are several defects that are very disappointing.
Comments (English): [ Disappointing ] || ---------------- || After several weeks of trying different ways to use this dishwasher, I have come to the conclusion that there are several defects that are very disappointing. First of all, you should know that there is no heating element for drying dishes. This makes it difficult for anything made of plastic to dry. And since it is the heat accumulated in the metal of the tub and in the dishes during washing that allows the dishes to dry, this means that the more plastic items there are, the less heat there is to dry everything. the dishes. You should therefore plan to only put a few pieces of plastic at a time otherwise you will have to wipe a large part of the dishes. The second major drawback of this device is that it is completely airtight. So if you leave it closed with dirty dishes (even well rinsed), foul odors inevitably develop. You should therefore always have an object, for example a towel, to prevent the door from closing completely. You must also put this object back in place each time you close the door. Likewise, as the tank is airtight, drying is more difficult since the humidity remains in the tank. So I plan each time to slightly open the door at the end of drying to let the humidity out in the form of steam. If you don't do this, many items won't dry. Also note that there is no grinder but rather a filter. So far, it hasn't really been a problem. I also wonder about the robustness of the lower baskets. The most positive point of this dishware is its quiet operation. On the other hand, the cycles are very long, but the washing is impeccable. The exterior stainless steel of the door is very thin, so it is very easy to dent.
Comments (Original): [ Décevant ] || ---------------- || Après plusieurs semaines à tenter différentes façons d’utiliser ce lave-vaisselle, j’en viens à la conclusion qu’il y a plusieurs défauts qui sont très décevants. Tout d’abord, il faut savoir qu’il n’y a pas d’élément chauffant pour le séchage de la vaisselle. Cela fait en sorte que tout ce qui est en plastique sèche difficilement. Et comme c’est la chaleur accumulées dans le métal de la cuve et dans la vaisselle lors du lavage qui permet de sécher la vaisselle, cela signifie que plus il y a d’articles en plastique, moins il y a de chaleur pour sécher toute la vaisselle. Il faut donc prévoir ne mettre que quelques de plastique à la fois sinon on doit essuyer une grande partie de la vaisselle. Le deuxième grand défaut de cet appareil, c’est qu’il est complètement hermétique. Ainsi si vous le laissez fermé avec de la vaisselle sale (même bien rincée), inévitablement des odeurs nauséabondes se développent. Il faut donc toujours prévoir un objet, par exemple une serviette, pour empêcher que la porte se ferme complètement. Il faut aussi remettre cet objet en place chaque fois que vous refermez la porte. De même, comme la cuve est hermétique, le séchage est plus difficile puisque l’humidité reste dans la cuve. Je prévois donc chaque fois d’entrouvrir la porte de la fin du séchage pour faire sortir l’humidité sous forme de vapeur. Si on ne le fait pas, plusieurs articles ne sèchent pas. sachez également qu’il n’y a pas de broyeur mais plutôt un filtre. Jusqu’à maintenant, ça ne pose pas vraiment de problème. Je me questionne également sur la robustesse des paniers inférieurs. Le point le plus positif de ce que la vaisselle est son fonctionnement silencieux. Par contre, les cycles sont très longs,mais le lavage est impeccable. L'acier inoxydable extérieur de la porte étant très mince, il est très facile de le bosser.

Comments (English): [ This machine will DESTROY your plastics.  ] || ---------------- || I've run this Series 300 dishwasher 3 times now. I researched Drying Options prior to buying. Sentence (English): In my opinion, Bosch products don't need any review, they speak for themselves and of course it's justifiably positive!
Comments (English): [ BOSCH house assistant ] || ---------------- || In my opinion, Bosch products don't need any review, they speak for themselves and of course it's justifiably positive! as for this specific model of the machine, I have no complaints. The control panel is simplified to use and only the inclusion of additional functions and the adjustment of basic parameters (water hardness, amount of rinse aid, sound signal volume, etc.) are simplified to the very limit of logic. The dish baskets are very well designed so that it is impossible for dishes to remain with food stains after washing. As an extra addition, I would like to praise the two plastic shelves in the upper shelf, which play a very important role in washing coffee cups and long pieces of cutlery. As for the noise level, it is quite quiet in operation, almost silent, so the indicator light comes in very handy whether it is washing or not. The only suggestion I would make is that this model could be added with the option of venting the condensation after washing the dishes so that the dishes are completely dry. All in all, I would highly recommend this machine, both for its ease of use and for its economic efficiency and performance.
Comments (Original): [ BOSCH kućna pomoćnica ] || ---------------- || Po mom mišljenju, Bosch proizvodima ne treba bilo kakva recenzija, oni govore sami za sebe i naravno to bude potpuno opravdano pozitivno!što se tiče konkretno ovog modela mašine, i nemam neke zamerke. Kontrolni panel je pojednostavljen za korišćenje i samo uključivanje dodatnih funkcija i podešavanje osnovnih parametara (tvrdoća vode, količina sredsva za ispiranje, jačina zvučnog signala itd.) su pojednostavljeni do same granice logike. Korpe posuđa su veoma dobro dizajnirane tako da je nemoguće da posuđe posle pranja ostane sa mrljama od hrane. Kao ekstra dodatak pohvalio bih u gornjoj polici dve plastične police koje imaju baš važnu ulogu pranju šoljica za kafu i dugačkih delova pribora za jelo.Što se tiče nivoa buke, poprilično je tiha u radu, gotovo nečujna tako da joj indikaciono svetlo itekako dobro dođe da li pere ili ne. Jedini predlog koji bih naveo je da bi moglo ovom modelu da se doda opcija ventiliranje kondenzacije nakon pranja posuđa kako bi posuđe bilo potpuno suvo. Sve u svemu toplo bih preporučio ovu mašinu što zbog svoje jednostavnosti rukovanja što zbog ekonomske isplativosti i učinka.

Sentence (English): I've been using this dishwasher for a few weeks now and I'm quite happy.
Comments (English): [ Great combination of features and price ] || ---------------- || I've been using this dishwasher for a few weeks now and I'm quite happy. I'm comparing it to a 2019 Kitchenaid from Costco it replaced (on its third pump assembly). Is this dishwasher louder than the Kitchenaid? Yes, but the specifications indicate as much. But it is not loud per se, it is mostly just water movement noise. It does sound like the insulation in the door or elsewhere isn't as thick but it's a different price point so I'm not going to fault it for that. Feature set is perfect for me, I don't need all the fancy features. What I love most about this dishwasher is the lack of a third rack and the extra depth of the top rack. It is fantastic. I find third racks completely useless. I can actually add a standard pasta pot to the top rack just like the Maytag advertisement indicates. That is incredibly useful to me. The 1hr wash works great while I use the Powerblast setting for pots and huge loads. Dishes are incredibly clean, filter basket easy to clean, buttons on front super easy to use and see. Looks great. I'm a fan! If it lasts 5 years I'll be content, 7 years quite happy, and if it makes it to 10 years I'll be very excited. Plus, the rack glide rails are better than my previous Kitchenaid. Very smooth. So yes, overall, I'm happy with the purchase and would recommend this unit at this time.

Comments (English): [ Avoid Samsung dishwasher model DW80R9950US ] || ---------------- || I purchased this dishwasher in December of 2022 and enjoyed 10 months of dependable and quiet performance. However, after these months the upper spray arm broke. A plastic part that clips the arm onto the middle rack became stretched causing the arm to fall down into the dishwasher with every use. The Geek Squad installed a replacement arm that broke, again, in less than a day. I tried to use the one-year warranty with Samsung, but my dealings with Samsung have been a disaster. Today I spent 20 minutes on the phone with an agent to generate a repair ticket, but the links that the agent sent don't work. First, a page reported that my machine was out of warranty (I previously provided Samsung with a copy of the Best Buy receipt), then a page listed the wrong symptom and provided no way for me to explain or confirm the problem, and then the next page wanted me to pay $365 for service. I followed up with the agent who sent me another link that was no more helpful. I sent additional texts, but they have not been answered. Between the unsuccessful attempt by Best Buy's Geek Squad (with a repair person who was completely unfamiliar with this model) and the spectacular indifference or antipathy that Samsung has towards its customers, I very much regret this purchase. Do NOT buy this dishwasher (I think that the design of the spray arm is faulty) and be very wary of Samsung. If you think you ever will need product support, do NOT buy a Samsung product.

Sentence (English): I have tested the Samsung Smart 46 dBA Dishwasher with StormWash DW80CG5451SR, Stainless Steel, I have about fifteen days using it, and I have already been able to test most of its functions and I have seen how well it works, it is quiet, spacious, brings three levels to place the dirty dish to wash, the first is thin for delicate and small utensils which is great because I no longer have to wash by hand that kind of stuff!
Comments (English): [ Efficient! ] || ---------------- || I have tested the Samsung Smart 46 dBA Dishwasher with StormWash DW80CG5451SR, Stainless Steel, I have about fifteen days using it, and I have already been able to test most of its functions and I have seen how well it works, it is quiet, spacious, brings three levels to place the dirty dish to wash, the first is thin for delicate and small utensils which is great because I no longer have to wash by hand that kind of stuff! You can also choose to use only the bottom level for washing, which allows you to wash a small amount of slabs and save water. Another thing I liked is that their trays have been designed in such a way that you arrange the dishes and none of them are stuck to each other, ensuring that the soap and water circulate on all sides. The middle tray ensures that glasses, small plates and the like stay firmly in place and the spaces are wide and my wider glasses fit perfectly. For the placement of the cutlery it has a basket very well distributed in spaces, it has two spaces to place thick-handled cutlery and several with holes where thin-handled cutlery fits, those can also be opened if you wish. The only thing is that this basket can only be used in the position in which it is, I mean you can not move it to another position because it does not fit anywhere else. It is easy to clean and fingerprints are not marked on the outside, to clean the internal filters is super easy and they are very thin which ensures that they trap very fine particles and thus protect the pump well! I also installed the application to control it from my cell phone, to be honest the process was not very friendly but after several attempts I managed it. In it you can control the inventory of your detergent and it notifies you how much you have it, in the same way I was able to activate the Energy saving AI mode which is great (but I'm not sure if it also saves water? ), in short I am very happy with the Samsung dishwasher, thank you The Insiders for the opportunity to participate in this campaign!

Sentence (English): This unit replaced a 30 year old Frigidare that let go and destroyed my laminate floor.
Comments (English): [ Build Quality ] || ---------------- || This unit replaced a 30 year old Frigidare that let go and destroyed my laminate floor. Not having had to buy a unit in many years, I knew there would be some changes - some good, some not so good. Since I can't give this unit a 4.5, I'll let it go with a 4. If it had a heated dry cycle, it would be a clear 5. Even without heated dry, I went with it for several reasons. Firstly, the build quality compared to most the competition is glaringly obvious. The door closes effortlessly, the wheels on the bottom rack are smooth and it tracks straight, the coating on the racks is thick and durable, not just some light coating. As far as features, the 3rd rack for silverware and larger utensils is very useful, and the middle rack will raise and lower easliy. The 3 series in particular has a clean looking control panel, easily readable LED lights, and just the right angle facing up at the user. It's a flush mount unit with no protruding handle, which I really like. A feature that was most helpful aiding install is the ability to adjust the rear height from the front of the unit; it has a through shaft which you can adjust with a screwdriver. This was helpful as I needed to lower the rear on install due to a small lip where my tile floor transitioned to the Luan section under the cabinet. It's a very quiet unit as well; you hardly know it's running. Lastly, it just looks good, and the stainless interior is worth the bump in money. If I had any complaints, it would be the long cycle time - which really isn't a complaint as it runs at night. Also, I would rather the water/drain hook-ups were located more in the center of the lower rear of the unit rather than being biased to one side. This made it a little tricky to guide them into the service opening in my cabinet, but it's not that difficult. I would prefer them at less of an angle going into the cabinet, but we'll see how that works out. That said, the install difficulty is about a 3 if you are installing it in an existing opening. While I could have bought another brand with a heated dry cycle, the Bosch does a good job within the limitation of not having that feature. I suspect this has been a thing in Europe for a long time so it's no surprise that it's here as well. Hopefully this unit provides many years of trouble-free service.

Sentence (English): THIS PRODUCT IS GOOD SO FAR, BUT AFTER ABOUT A YEAR IS STARTING TO BREAK DOWN A LITTLE.
Comments (English): [ One year old and so far pretty good machine. ] || ---------------- || THIS PRODUCT IS GOOD SO FAR, BUT AFTER ABOUT A YEAR IS STARTING TO BREAK DOWN A LITTLE. The clips on the dishracks that make some parts of the rack movable to allow for different sizes of items to be washed and alternative loading patterns are breaking down and do not hold the racks in position properly any longer. We have to hold the movable parts of the racks in place with elastic bands from broccoli bunches etc. Minor defects are that the utensils basket has fairly large holes in the bottom. It's okay for western knives and forks, but each load my wife, who is Korean, has to wash lots of thin steel Korean chopsticks which slip right through the holes at the bottom of the utensil basket. We had to substitute a plastic pencil holder or some such with smaller holes to be able to machine wash the chopsticks. Other than this, the machine is extremely quiet, and seems to wash the dishes well on 60 minute \"Quickwash\" as well as the longer regular wash. It is only about a year old, but so far we'd buy it again, but wish the rack clips were more reliable, and that the utensil basket had offered an optional-to-use insert with smaller holes for chopsticks. The reason I am giving it four instead of five stars is that I have a concern, based largely on the trouble with the rack clips, that it may break down and have to be replaced fairly quickly, which leads to a certain constant anxiety about the appliance which is unpleasant. If it doesn't degrade further, then is is four and a half or even five stars in terms of satisfaction, but the anxiety detracts from being able to fully relax and so to speak, forget about it which would be the ideal.

Sentence (English): I want to be fair.
Comments (English): [ Brand new dishwasher already needs repair.  ] || ---------------- || I want to be fair. When the washer works it works pretty well. I have only had the dishwasher installed since August. There were installation issues with the techs but nothing with the dishwasher. Got it in late August and have been using about 4x times a week for the past 8-10 weeks. Definitely suggest rinsing dishes before hand to get best results. Even with Cascade Platinum it can leave some residue. Here is the issue. After 8-10 weeks and maybe 40 times using it, the dishwasher needs repair. It is showing a code and won't run. Says it needs a new circuit board. Took forever to get things registered to use the warranty. Once I was able to get into the warranty repair system, the next appointment was a week out. The week of the appointment the company called me and told me they went ahead and ordered the part due to the error code. So until that part comes in my appointment is on hold. Also was told the part would take 15 days + to arrive if in stock. So I might be without use of my brand new dishwasher for the next month or so. Avoid buying a whirlpool product. I posted about this on social media and I cannot tell you how many people I know who are in the same situation with their dishwashers, fridges and washing machines. I loved the dishwasher due to how it runs and the third rack. But it takes about 3-4 hours for a full cycle and that is crazy long.

Sentence (English): THIS PRODUCT IS GOOD SO FAR, BUT AFTER ABOUT A YEAR IS STARTING TO BREAK DOWN A LITTLE.
Comments (English): [ One year old and so far pretty good machine. ] || ---------------- || THIS PRODUCT IS GOOD SO FAR, BUT AFTER ABOUT A YEAR IS STARTING TO BREAK DOWN A LITTLE. The clips on the dishracks that make some parts of the rack movable to allow for different sizes of items to be washed and alternative loading patterns are breaking down and do not hold the racks in position properly any longer. We have to hold the movable parts of the racks in place with elastic bands from broccoli bunches etc. Minor defects are that the utensils basket has fairly large holes in the bottom. It's okay for western knives and forks, but each load my wife, who is Korean, has to wash lots of thin steel Korean chopsticks which slip right through the holes at the bottom of the utensil basket. We had to substitute a plastic pencil holder or some such with smaller holes to be able to machine wash the chopsticks. Other than this, the machine is extremely quiet, and seems to wash the dishes well on 60 minute "Quickwash" as well as the longer regular wash. It is only about a year old, but so far we'd buy it again, but wish the rack clips were more reliable, and that the utensil basket had offered an optional-to-use insert with smaller holes for chopsticks. The reason I am giving it four instead of five stars is that I have a concern, based largely on the trouble with the rack clips, that it may break down and have to be replaced fairly quickly, which leads to a certain constant anxiety about the appliance which is unpleasant. If it doesn't degrade further, then is is four and a half or even five stars in terms of satisfaction, but the anxiety detracts from being able to fully relax and so to speak, forget about it which would be the ideal.

Sentence (English): I bought a house that the dishwasher had never been used, but was a couple years old.
Comments (English): [ Not a fan ] || ---------------- || I bought a house that the dishwasher had never been used, but was a couple years old. I don't know if that had anything to do with it going out, but I had my brother install a new GE dishwasher in my home. I have no idea how long ago that was, but I don't think I used it for more than a year and just decided to go back to handwashing. This dishwasher didn't seem to particularly get the dishes clean and well if it doesn't do that then what's the point in having it? Fast forward a few years and I am selling my house. I bought some stuff to clean the dishwasher out so it would be nice for the new owners and I noticed there was no power to the dishwasher. I checked the breaker and nothing was tripped. I have no idea when it only worked for maybe a year why it would suddenly just short out, but I am entirely positive that I did NOT get my money's worth. I would not recommend unless you don't like clean dishes or don't like appliances to work properly AND you love to throw money away.

And the dishwasher has a "half-load" option but no way that I've seen to select whether it is a top half or bottom half, and it did not get the dishes very clean.

Lastly, it just looks good, and the stainless interior is worth the bump in money.If I had any complaints, it would be the long cycle time - which really isn't a complaint as it runs at night. Also, I would rather the water/drain hook-ups were located more in the center of the lower rear of the unit rather than being biased to one side. Sentence (English): DisappointingAfter several weeks of trying different ways to use this dishwasher, I have come to the conclusion that there are several defects which are very disappointing.
Comments (English): [ Disappointing ] || ---------------- || DisappointingAfter several weeks of trying different ways to use this dishwasher, I have come to the conclusion that there are several defects which are very disappointing. First of all, you should know that there is no heating element for drying dishes. This makes it difficult for anything made of plastic to dry. And since it is the heat accumulated in the metal of the tub and in the dishes during washing that allows the dishes to dry, this means that the more plastic items there are, the less heat there is to dry everything. the dishes. You should therefore plan to only put a few pieces of plastic at a time otherwise you will have to wipe a large part of the dishes. The second major drawback of this device is that it is completely airtight. So if you leave it closed with dirty dishes (even well rinsed), foul odors inevitably develop. You should therefore always have an object, for example a towel, to prevent the door from closing completely. You must also put this object back in place each time you close the door. Likewise, as the tank is airtight, drying is more difficult since the humidity remains in the tank. So I plan each time to slightly open the door at the end of drying to let the humidity out in the form of steam. If you don't do this, many items won't dry. Also note that there is no grinder but rather a filter. So far, it hasn't really been a problem. I also wonder about the robustness of the lower baskets. The most positive point of this dishware is its quiet operation. On the other hand, the cycles are very long.

Tout d’abord, il faut savoir qu’il n’y a pas d’élément chauffant pour le séchage de la vaisselle. Cela fait en sorte que tout ce qui est en plastique sèche difficilement. Et comme c’est la chaleur accumulées dans le métal de la cuve et dans la vaisselle lors du lavage qui permet de sécher la vaisselle, cela signifie que plus il y a d’articles en plastique, moins il y a de chaleur pour sécher toute la vaisselle. Il faut donc prévoir ne mettre que quelques de plastique à la fois sinon on doit essuyer une grande partie de la vaisselle. Le deuxième grand défaut de cet appareil, c’est qu’il est complètement hermétique. Ainsi si vous le laisser fermé avec de la vaisselle sale (même bien rincée), inévitablement des odeurs nauséabondes se développent. Il faut donc toujours prévoir un objet, par exemple une serviette, pour empêcher que la porte se ferme complètement. Il faut aussi remettre cet objet en place chaque fois que vous refermez la porte. De même, comme la cuve est hermétique, le séchage est plus difficile puisque l’humidité reste dans la cuve. Je me questionne également sur la robustesse des paniers inférieurs. Le point le plus positif de ce que la vaisselle est son fonctionnement silencieux. Par contre, les cycles sont très longs.

Comments (English): [ Don't Buy!  ] || ---------------- || Don't buy! I have had this oven for over 5 months and have had the repairmen out 6 times. The oven does not heat properly. A LG tech said they are only allowed to be on the phone for 10 mins so their support is minimal. Thermostat, circuit boards and heating elements have been replaced twice and still there has not been any change. I thought I met the requirement of parts replaced 3 times within 3 months then found out that it has to be 3 repairs in 3 month by the same person. Finally got a LG tech on the phone that could not figure out what the problem is and issued a TCC number, which goes to LG management for disposition to determine if it was unrepairable. It was denied. They insisted on another repair. New repair did not worked so I called LG again. Yesterday they scheduled a Certified LG Tech to come out and disposition it. No one showed up today. Called LG again and they said they are no Certified LG Techs in my area so they can't send anyone out and agreed I was lied to. They said I have to schedule through an appliance repair company again. Through multiple phone calls (~20) I am told they will contact me within 24-48 hours. Only twice did someone call me back. They change to rules consistently and have many excuses including blaming the customer but I have been baking for 50 years and know how an oven should work. It's pretty basic stuff, turn it on and it heats to the proper temperature. The quality of LGs products and their warrenty are terrible. I will never buy another LG product. Back to making phone calls. Round and round we go….

Comments (English): [ LG dishwashers are a must-have in this smart age! ] || ---------------- || I threw away the old gas range/oven combo in my 10-year-old newlywed home and replaced it with a built-in dishwasher and induction cooktop. :) At first, I chose a brand-new one that was easy to clean with water. But after 10 years, they were giving me a little something to compensate for. Since I was buying anyway, I decided to get a domestically produced one, which is also a huge hit. I decided to cancel the order the day before delivery. That's how I ended up with the LG dishwasher. Among the 12-person, large-capacity models, only LG was available from Medin Korea. The LG Dios Objet Collection dishwasher with steam and hot air dryer. It's a 12-person, solid green dishwasher with free on-site installation. I received a text message about the delivery the day I ordered. A professional LG technician visited the next day. He determined the installation location and coordinated the schedule. The owner of the furniture store came to pick up my old appliances for free. He even called the gas station to shut it off (this process took a day). Rocket Installation + LG Electronics. It was truly a dishwasher that was unparalleled in both cleaning and drying! These are dishes I use every day. A washing course using 100 degree Celsius true steam and high temperature micro steam. You can use it with more confidence :) . It uses a total of 54 water streams to clean every corner of the dishes. It uses a water softener while rinsing to further reduce water stains ~. Condensation drying, automatic door opening drying, hot air drying, drying only course, night quiet course, etc. It has functions such as a 10-year free warranty inverter DD motor, low power design, night quiet course, double noise reduction material, and alarm sound (high/low/off) ~. It kills both bacteria and noise! Wow. Hand washing --> It's a whole new world of dishwashing. You have to wash rice and food particles first, but it's not annoying because it's just to remove residue. (Before, I used to wash the dishes myself during the first wash. I regret it). But this is on a whole different level. My husband was the coolest when he told me to buy a dishwasher instead of bags and clothes. It goes like this: dishwasher -> dryer -> vacuum cleaner -> drink. The convenience and hygiene are top-notch! The lower shelf can be adjusted to three heights, and the top multi-purpose dish rack can store everything from small dishes to large pots (even a grill ^^ no scratches). The smart shelf system is also super convenient :). I used to visit offline stores to carefully compare and research before buying appliances, but times have changed. It's so convenient to buy online. I can compare everything ~~ Plus, the explanations are detailed (ThinQ app synergy). My own purchase review

Comments (English): [ LG dishwashers are a must-have in this smart age! ] || ---------------- || I threw away the old gas range/oven combo in my 10-year-old newlywed home and replaced it with a built-in dishwasher and induction cooktop. :) At first, I chose a brand-new one that was easy to clean with water. But after 10 years, they were giving me a little something to compensate for. Since I was buying anyway, I decided to get a domestically produced one, which is also a huge hit. I decided to cancel the order the day before delivery. That's how I ended up with the LG dishwasher. Among the 12-person, large-capacity models, only LG was available from Medin Korea. The LG Dios Objet Collection dishwasher with steam and hot air dryer. It's a 12-person, solid green dishwasher with free on-site installation. I received a text message about the delivery the day I ordered. A professional LG technician visited the next day. He determined the installation location and coordinated the schedule. The owner of the furniture store came to pick up my old appliances for free. He even called the gas station to shut it off (this process took a day). Rocket Installation + LG Electronics. It was truly a dishwasher that was unparalleled in both cleaning and drying! These are dishes I use every day. A washing course using 100 degree Celsius true steam and high temperature micro steam. You can use it with more confidence :) . It uses a total of 54 water streams to clean every corner of the dishes. It uses a water softener while rinsing to further reduce water stains ~. Condensation drying, automatic door opening drying, hot air drying, drying only course, night quiet course, etc. It has functions such as a 10-year free warranty inverter DD motor, low power design, night quiet course, double noise reduction material, and alarm sound (high/low/off) ~. It kills both bacteria and noise! Wow. Hand washing --> It's a whole new world of dishwashing. You have to wash rice and food particles first, but it's not annoying because it's just to remove residue. (Before, I used to wash the dishes myself during the first wash. I regret it). But this is on a whole different level. My husband was the coolest when he told me to buy a dishwasher instead of bags and clothes. It goes like this: dishwasher -> dryer -> vacuum cleaner -> drink. It's so convenient to buy online. I can compare everything ~~ Plus, the explanations are detailed (ThinQ app synergy). My own purchase review

Comments (English): [ LG dishwashers are a must-have in this smart age! ] || ---------------- || I threw away the old gas range/oven combo in my 10-year-old newlywed home and replaced it with a built-in dishwasher and induction cooktop. :) At first, I chose a brand-new one that was easy to clean with water. I decided to cancel the order the day before delivery. That's how I ended up with the LG dishwasher. Among the 12-person, large-capacity models, only LG was available from Medin Korea. Comments (English): [ Complex install, complicated programming, … ] || ---------------- || slow to wash; very slow dry; complex programmingInstall procedures on-line different than those shipped with the unit. For instance, on-line shows hard wire install option. If you live in spec or tract house, your ordinal dishwasher was probably hard wired. It costs builders less money to hard wire than add an outlet. I pulled old dishwasher & prepared cabinet for new installation. When new washer arrived, instructions indicated "Do not hard wire." Fortunately I had the correct sized hole saw to accommodate a flex line & surface mounted GFIC.Drawers seem to allow more moisture into the cabinet cavity. Include rubber lining is extremely thin. I had enough heavy rubber window flashing to adequately cover the cabinet cavity. Buy ~15' before installing.Instructions little help. Fortunately, we found a helpful GE tech support gal who could walk us through the "complicated" set up. Beware full wash & dry cycle with 2 drawers is ~3 hrs.Use rinse agent to get adequate drying.

Sentence (English): I am disappointed in the Bosch 300 series dishwasher.

All the ads says it cleans the dishes and all I need to do is scrape off the food but when I do that, the food is still on the dishes when the cycle is done. Also, when I put on the 'extra dry' feature, there is still water on the dishes. I have had the dishwasher for about 3 weeks. I LOVE the top (3rd tray)! I can put things on that tray that I had to could never put in my old dishwasher due to the fact they were too small. I also like the silverware tray that keeps the silverware from nesting. I love how quiet it is, too.

Sentence (English): This was my first purchase of an appliance from Costco.
Comments (English): [ Don't be in a hurry ] || ---------------- || This was my first purchase of an appliance from Costco. Purchased this dishwasher on 8/30, when my unit developed a leak. Delivery date was scheduled for 2 weeks later. Although inconvenient went and purchased it foregoing the big box stores. It was delivered by the scheduled date. I never spoke with logistics and called regarding the installation and was given contact information for the 3rd party installer. Called them and told it would be done on Saturday a couple of days later. This installer is located in Florida and was dispatching an installer from Tennessee, I live in Alabama. Saturday came no installer by mid morning I tried calling but the office in Florida is not open on the weekends. Installation was done Thursday of the following week. When installing the unit we were charged an additional $35 and asked to make the check payable directly to them and we did so. After they left we noticed hot water pressure from the kitchen faucet was gone. After calling Costco logistics they arranged for a return visit and refunded the money paid to the installer since they are not supposed to be up-charging. Costco has selected the wrong company to partner with. It has made dissuaded me from any future appliance purchase. Costco take note that this contractor is damaging your reputation. Buyers beware it will take time to get your appliance running if installation is beyond just plugging it in

Sentence (English): I have purchased this dishwasher elsewhere, but I am leaving a review in case anyone is interested.
Comments (English): [ Surprised with this dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I have purchased this dishwasher elsewhere, but I am leaving a review in case anyone is interested. The truth is that when I saw it, as soon as I saw it, I fell in love. It has 4 propellers at the bottom with movements as if they were airplane flaps. The propeller at the top is wide, both are robust. It has good space inside and many positions, that is, the pivots that hold the plates or glasses have the option of folding them, being able to place paellas or tupperware in those areas without having to place them incorrectly. I also really liked the Steam theme, I had not seen it in any dishwasher. And it is a function that I really like and use it from time to time. Especially when things are very dirty. Additionally, by having high temperatures you eliminate bacteria and if there is a family member with gastroenteritis, etc. Well, you eliminate all the viruses there. Leaves the dishes, tableware, paella pans and pots very clean, especially with high temperatures that you can activate or not Like Steam. It has an upper tray that you can modify its height, making it more comfortable to place taller pots on the bottom. As a negative point, I think it makes a lot of noise, everything and installing it with its rubber bands, etc. anti noise that it brings for its installation. It is easy to install, you connect it to the water, the drain and the voltage and it works. Because of the Wifi and its app, they are not bad, you can add types of washes, etc. and programs. apart from seeing the process and how much is left. It's a shame that you can't link it to Alexa or apps like smart life. With the app you can see how many cycles you have done when you have to add salt and rinse aid, etc. It has the typical melody that owners of LG devices dance when the process ends but you can remove it from the APP but if you remove it you will not belong to the LG sect ;) and its little dances ;=). Happy with the brand and I like it more and more, from televisions to home appliances, good designs and high quality. I'm not convinced by the eco program, spending 3-4 hours washing seems excessive to me. Normally I use the turbo program with extra heat and the dishes, pots and paellas come out clean and perfect. You have the drying option that leaves the dishes and everything you put on it very dry. Of course, plastic things like tupperware don't seem to affect drying and come out with drops, but what are glasses, paella dishes, everything comes out perfectly dry. Very happy with the dishwasher, I recommend it

Sentence (English): Please read all the negative reviews.
Comments (English): [ Designed to FAIL after 2 years! PLEASE READ!  ] || ---------------- || Please read all the negative reviews. You'll notice they have something in common. The pump dies in 2 years. For a $1200 dishwasher I expected it to last a long time. HERE IS WHY IT FAILS. DESIGN FLAW BUILT ON PURPOSE! Besides looking at all the fancy features you should look at the bottom of the dishwasher to see the FILTER. This collects all the fine particles. This model has NO filter in the bottom. It has a collection tray but that doesn't stop stuff like small pieces and hair. There IS a filter. It's inside the main pump under the dishwasher! You have to uninstall the dishwasher, lay it on its side, remove the entire pump assembly and then access the filter. You don't have any way to know when the filter is plugged until the wash circulation pump dies, which is the most expensive part on the dishwasher! KitchenAid puts proprietary clamps on to keep customers out but I replaced them with regular ones. I guess KitchenAid assumes if you can pay a ton for a dishwasher then you can pay a ton every time the pumps goes out. I fixed mine and I'm selling it because by design, it'll do it again! Also, this dishwasher is a Whirlpool with all Whirlpool parts. It just has a thicker insulation pad to make it a tad more quiet. All part numbers are Whirlpool parts. That's why it performs like a Whirlpool. There's a Whirlpool model for half the price with the same design at Lowe's. It looks the same because it IS the same and I don't recommend that one either. All these positive reviews are from new users right after they get it. Two years later I imagine those positive reviews would be negative. KitchenAid/Whirlpool should be sued for this ridiculous design! Never again will I ever buy a KitchenAid/Whirlpool/Maytag/Amana product from them!

Sentence (English): Cons: It's a bit noisy, but I guess that's unavoidable.
Comments (English): Cons: It's a bit noisy, but I guess that's unavoidable. Since I bought a dishwasher, I've hated the pile of dishes, so I tried running it once in the morning, but I realized I shouldn't run it late at night. It's a bit noisy, but I think that's something to consider. Pros: I live alone, and it seems like it's enough for two people. I was worried because of some reviews saying it didn't clean cleanly, but after pre-rinsing with water to remove any sticky rice and residue, and running it on high speed for 35 minutes, the dishes and spoons shine. At first, I was worried it wouldn't clean cleanly, so I set it to 1-hour mode. But after a quick pre-rinsing, high speed mode is more than enough. I thought the high speed mode didn't have a door-opening function, but it does, and it's great because it even has a door-opening function and dries the dishes. I bought it for the automatic door-opening and drying mode, so I'm quite satisfied. I haven't cleaned the inside yet, but the strainer is removable and washable, and the design matches my home's ambiance, so I like it. The biggest con: the noise. So, I think it's better to just run it for 35 minutes and finish it. Now I don't have to worry about dishes piling up, I don't have to worry about germs on my sponge, and it saves time, so I think it was a good purchase.

Sentence (English): We've had it about a month now.
Comments (English): We've had it about a month now. Very unimpressed from the beginning. The pictures show it coming with padding that goes around it to insulate and keep it quiet. However it wasn't delivered with it. It took over a week for HD/Bosch to figure out that model doesn't come with it even though it's pictured on Bosch's website that way. The dishwasher itself provides lackluster cleaning. Dishes with little food on them still come out dirty yet the jets are apparently strong enough to flip lightweight objects over and throw them around the machine even landing on the bottom of the dishwasher. It doesn't dry well at all even on “extra dry”. Which is ridiculous…it's either dry or wet. Extra dry shouldn't even be a thing. If you want it to dry “okay” you absolutely have to use the rinse aid which is consumed at a high rate. The only reason I'm giving it a fair rating instead of poor is because it is very quiet. Disappointed and would not recommend.

Sentence (English): Let me say that I would buy this DW again.
Comments (English): [ Overall a great DW, but Room for Improvement ] || ---------------- || Let me say that I would buy this DW again. However, there are a few tweaks that could make it much better. 1. Only way to see how much time is remaining until completion is to open the door and look at the display on top of the door or look at the app on the phone. Many times the the phone app has difficulty connecting. Other times if connects immediately, but it still is somewhat a pain when you only want to see the time remaining. 2. On the DW, to adjust settings or setup, the manual tells you to press the "Setup 3 Seconds". This is not correct, you press the "express" above where it says "Setup 3 Seconds" for 3 seconds. The DW could be marked better to make this more clear, and somewhere in the manual it could explain the you hold the express "button" for 3 seconds. 3. Bottom rack- From looking at Bosch videos, I see some DW allow every other tine to be folded down. This DW does not have that, and it would be nice for deeper pans or dishes. Once again, so far, I'm happy with the DW, but there are oportunities for improvement.

I lost my patience at that point (almost an hour of dealing with her) and told her to put on a supervisor. She told me there were no supervisors available so they would have to call me back….that was almost two weeks ago and I still haven't heard from anyone. I am so sorry I didn't stick with GE. The one I had before I ordered this was still working perfectly after 20 years. I am disappointed in Costco and would never buy another LG product!

Sentence (English): I bought this dishwasher, for my new house, 2 years ago, and I couldn't be more unhappy with it.
Comments (English): [ LARGE PROGRAMS ] || ---------------- || I bought this dishwasher, for my new house, 2 years ago, and I couldn't be more unhappy with it. The programs are eternal, and if the steam option is selected, it turns off and let's go, and to make matters worse, the pots do not come out clean, there are even times when I have to put it on a second time, and let it be noted that I put them in previously rinsed, and practically already clean, for the same reason. Even with the intensive program with hot water, I can't get them to turn out well, with a 3:35h program. The dishwasher I had in the other house was a Balay and with a 1-hour program everything turned out perfectly. Frankly, I feel very disappointed, I bought it for the steam function, a function that I do not use, because I spend 4 hours or so washing. What I don't spend on electricity due to energy efficiency, I spend corrected and increased, due to the hours it takes to wash and the poor results in terms of cleaning, so I do not recommend this dishwasher. I'm even considering changing it, after only 2 years of use. I don't really understand the number of good reviews, for me it has been a total disappointment.
Comments (Original): [ PROGRAMAS LARGUISIMOS ] || ---------------- || Compré este lavavajillas, para mi nueva casa, hace 2 años, y no puedo estar más descontenta con él. Los programas son eternos, y si se selecciona la opción vapor, ya apaga y vámonos, y para colmo, los cacharros no salen limpios, incluso hay veces que lo tengo que poner una segunda vez, y que conste que los meto previamente enjuagados, y prácticamente ya limpios, por el mismo motivo. Ni siquiera con el programa intensivo con agua caliente, consigo que salgan bien, con un programa de 3:35h. El lavavajillas que tenía en la otra casa era un Balay y con un programa de 1h salía todo perfecto. Francamente, me siento muy decepcionada, lo compré por la función vapor, función que no uso, porque me voy a 4h y pico de lavado. Lo que no gasto de luz por eficiencia energética, lo gasto corregido y aumentado, por las horas que tarda en lavar y los bajos resultados en cuanto a limpieza, así que no recomiendo este lavavajillas. Incluso, me estoy planteando cambiarlo, después de tan solo 2 años de uso. no entiendo muy bien la cantidad de buenas reseñas, para mi ha sido un chasco total.

Auto door opening: Yes. This was my first dishwasher purchase after moving, so I researched and debated for a long time, and I decided on the DUBJ1E model. I'm a regular customer of Coupang Rocket Installation, so I chose a product that supports Rocket Installation. I didn't need it immediately, and it was a pricey appliance. I monitored the price frequently, going back and forth between stocks. I finally got it at a reasonable price. The color matches my kitchen perfectly, and it's beautiful. I just need it to wash cleanly, and I don't need steam. I figured a high-temperature dryer would suffice. I've been using it for three months now, using almost all the standard features. I think my decision was a good one, as I don't need many features. The installer was quick and clean on the requested date, and I was very happy with the clean installation. I've been using it for over three months now, and I haven't had any issues. I'm so grateful to be freed from the long dishwashing cycle. A dishwasher is truly an essential appliance. I don't really need a water softener, so I don't use salt. Connecting to the LG app allows you to download courses. Best of all, it's convenient because I can just search the app's user manual whenever I have a question. It's almost silent even when I run it in the evening, and if I turn it off, the door opens silently without a closing sound, leaving the clothes well-dried the next morning. I was worried about the electricity bill, but the low-power design reportedly uses only 1 kWh per standard cycle. The height-adjustable top shelf and top drawer are really convenient, and the detergent dispenser is located in the bottom drawer, which is really nice. I don't feel it's necessary, so I don't use the built-in detergent dispenser. I use an all-in-one tablet detergent, so I don't even need conditioner. Since I'm renting, I was worried about having to cut furniture and having to restore it to its original condition. Sentence (English): I have had this for over a month and few things I would change about the dishwasher and the process.
Comments (English): [ Quiet, but some minor flaws ] || ---------------- || I have had this for over a month and few things I would change about the dishwasher and the process. First, I was replacing a 20-year old GE dishwasher that is built like a tank. It still worked, but never really dried the dishes well. This one was reviewed by Consumer Reports and did well, so we gave it a try. So, here are the highlights, if you are replacing an older dishwasher, you may need a new electrical box to connect it to your house. The installer had one, but it was an additional $100 on the spot, so add that to the cost. Second, my biggest complaint is that the door feels very flimsy and twists slightly when open and closing it. Third, there is no way to warn someone if you just washed dished or only used the rinse cycle. If someone opens it after the 9-minute rinse cycle they could potentially think the dishes were cleaned and try to put them away. I will probably add a \"dirty/clean\" magnet for others in the house to be aware of this, but that takes away from the clean aesthetic of the front. Fourth, the top rack gets really hot and has melted the coating off of some KitchenAid knives, so be careful. Lastly, the dryer seems to get things really dry about 50% of the time, so additional drying may still be needed especially on plastic items. As for the good, it cleans very, very well even though the cycle time is typically 2 hours. It is extremely quiet--I mean \"really\" quiet-- and it shows a solid red light on the floor when it's running so you can see that it's on at a glance. Its modular design is great for different sized items from pots and pans to small silverware. Overall, it is very easy to use even though 90% of the time I just use \"Auto\". Even with its faults, it's miles ahead of my old dishwasher. I would definitely buy it again just for the quiet operation. Did I mention it was quiet?

Sentence (English): The Bosch 500 Series dishwasher is quiet and efficient!
Comments (English): [ Love our new dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || The Bosch 500 Series dishwasher is quiet and efficient! I was thinking about replacing our glasses as they were looking old and cloudy, but after a few cycles though the new dishwasher, they were restored to looking like they're new! Absolutely love the addition of a silverware tray at the very top. We can load the various utensils so that, when they are clean, each group can be easily scooped up by their handles and dropped in their place in the drawer away all at once instead of trying to fish them out of the tray without handling the business ends or getting poked by something sharp. Also love the top tray for small things like sippy lids and chip clips. We use the silverware trays on the bottom shelf for the larger spatulas and cooking utensils. I also appreciate the ability to easily change the height of the middle rack to accommodate taller items. I read a lot about dishwashers and looked at different makes and models in six stores before selecting this one. No regrets--would definitely choose it again!

Sentence (English): This machine has a touch control pad with indicator lights that I did not know how to use at first.
Comments (English): [ Good machine, terrible instruction manual ] || ---------------- || This machine has a touch control pad with indicator lights that I did not know how to use at first. I did not find either the quickstart manual or the online manual easy to follow, and I was cursing Bosch for that at first, since my old Bosch machine had been easy to operate even without a manual. It took me most of a day to figure out by trial and error where to touch the panel to turn on the machine or change the settings; the manual left too much out, and the machine didn't respond as described when I followed the instructions that WERE included. Now my husband and I just stick with one basic setting, push ON and GO, then close the machine to start it. I've forgotten how to do anything else and what all the labels and lights mean. That said, I'm happy with how the machine operates on that one basic setting. The dishes get clean with no pre-rinsing, and they are drier than they were after washing in my old Bosch machine. I find it easy to load the detergent and rinse aid, although the rinse aid seems to start leaking out around the sides of the container before it is full, which may be a defect. The dish rack tines are positioned better for my dishes than the ones in my old machine were, and so I have a greater load capacity than before. I thought I would use the new third utensil rack every day, but I don't; I often forget it's there until I miss some utensil and remember to look there. I did buy a second silverware basket at Goodwill, and I use that most days;the one included had more useable space than the one in my old Bosch, but it was still too small for my needs. So far, we use the machine once a day to handle the dishes for two people eating two meals each. We've had both big racks full on two occasions, and they also came out clean and dry.

Sentence (English): My family purchased this dishwasher to complete a kitchen renovation.
Comments (English): [ Leaks, physical damage, no resolution ] || ---------------- || My family purchased this dishwasher to complete a kitchen renovation. After a few washes, the unit began leaking out the left side of the door and onto the floor. Lucky that I installed water sensors in the new kitchen so the floors do not seem to be damaged yet. I received no help from a Lowe's technician through the protection policy so I contacted Samsung. The technician identified a dent in the interior - top front left - that he said is the cause of the leaking. However, he told me physical damage is not covered under Samsung's warranty. The dent is not noticeable to the average consumer, and the technician needed to remove the third rack to see it. I believe it would be visible on the exterior but Samsung's manual explicitly states to not remove the sound dampening insulation. I have been on the phone multiple times with both companies, and each is pointing at the other. I am extremely disappointed that neither Samsung nor Lowe's will stand by their product, as we have purchased multiple appliances. I am wary of buying another appliance or electronic from either company unless this is resolved in a satisfactory manner.
